image_description: A close-up, vertical crop of a wooden wind instrument, specifically the lower joint or boot section of a bassoon. The image shows the dark reddish-brown polished wood grain, silver-plated metal keys and rods, and white decorative line inlays running vertically along the wood. The background is a plain, textured grey fabric.

The object is clearly constructed from turned wood segments joined together, evidenced by the continuous grain and decorative lines.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic identity of the instrument segment and distinguish it from similar woodwinds like oboes or clarinets based on keywork and wood grain.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the wood grain and metal reflections, checking for AI-generated smearing or inconsistent specular highlights.
To verify the physical connectivity of the complex metal keywork to the wooden body, ensuring no floating elements or fused boundaries typical of AI generation.

focus_areas: Metal key reflection and edge sharpness
Connectivity between keys and wooden body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus on the micro-texture of the wood and the mechanical plausibility of the keywork. AI often fails to render the complex linkage of bassoon keys correctly, resulting in fused rods or impossible pivot points. Verify if the 'white lines' are crisp inlays or blurry artifacts.
